integrity: The primary public full text was inspected at the transformed moment integral, Eqs. (3.5)-(3.8), the MGF construction Eqs. (3.9)-(3.12), the parameter domain, and the reported real-data MLE. An independent 2026 unit arcsine-exponential special-case moment formula was compared. The earliest public bibliographic record located is dated 15 May 2026; the AIMS article page/PDF also displays 19 May 2026. The standalone checker was replayed from the packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The exact convergence region of the full double series for k>1 is not classified.
The result addresses ordinary convergence of the printed series, not generalized summation methods.
Separate Rényi-entropy and likelihood formulas are outside this finding.
title: The UASWD moment series diverges on part of its admissible parameter space
